semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides testing equipment and services across the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Wuhan Jingce Electronic Group Co., Ltd. specializes in comprehensive testing technology services for the semiconductor industry, covering processes from front-end to back-end testing. With a strong focus on R&D and innovation, the company aims to be a leading integrated service provider in the semiconductor and display sectors.

regional_presence.China: The company has multiple R&D centers and manufacturing bases across various cities in China, including Wuhan, Shanghai, and Beijing.
regional_presence.United States: Wuhan Jingce has established a presence with R&D capabilities in the United States.
regional_presence.Japan: The company maintains R&D operations in Japan.
regional_presence.South Korea: Wuhan Jingce has R&D centers in South Korea.
